# Code of conduct

We want this project to be a respectful and welcoming place for everyone who uses or contributes to it.

## Expected behaviour

- Be respectful and constructive, and assume good intent.
- Keep discussions technical and focused on the work.
- Accept feedback gracefully and give it kindly.
- Respect the privacy of others and never publish personal data, credentials or real invoices.

## Unacceptable behaviour

- Harassment, discrimination, insults or personal attacks.
- Trolling, deliberate disruption or repeated off-topic posts.
- Publishing private information of others without their permission.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may edit or remove comments, issues and pull requests, and may block people who do not follow this
code of conduct. To report a problem, use GitHub's "Report content" feature on the item, or open a private security
advisory for the repository as described in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) and mention that the report concerns
conduct.
